critique.evidence: Measured loading and stability are demo-ready across all three viewports: LCP is 1700 ms desktop, 1644 ms tablet, and 516 ms mobile; FCP is 116/164/68 ms; CLS is 0.00046/0.04778/0; and document width matches viewport everywhere. There are no console, page, or request failures. Motion is generally stable, though desktop averages 22.36 ms per frame with a 50 ms worst frame and 1.22% long-frame ratio. Transfer cost is comparatively heavy at 1.30 MB, driven by 1.14 MB of JavaScript, for 17 requests.
critique.fix: Reduce the 1.14 MB JavaScript payload through route-level code splitting and dead-code removal, then profile desktop rendering to keep average frames below 16.7 ms and eliminate the 50 ms spike; also investigate the tablet CLS of 0.0478.
